**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (docs-only; independent review of an owner draft)

**What looks good**
- Trial merge with current origin/main is clean (AGENTS.md auto-merges; no conflicts).
- Nothing functional reads ROADMAP.md: no script, workflow, test, `include_str!` or build file opens it. Remaining mentions are prose/provenance comments (cli.rs:12 and similar `specced from ROADMAP Mx.y`), the release template, and history docs, all left on purpose and still true via git history.
- `git show v0.14.0:ROADMAP.md` resolves, so the AGENTS.md and README pointers work. `docs/spike-egui-go-no-go.md` exists, so the retargeted LICENSES.md and Cargo.toml comments are valid.
- Audit spot-check: 35 issue numbers checked against GitHub, and every one exists with the stated state. Examples: #5, #6, #44, #47, #220, #7, #33, #23-#27, #29-#32, #35, #39, #48, #212 are open; #8, #13, #14, #18, #19, #20, #22, #28, #34, #36-#38, #40, #46 are closed. #21 is open as claimed.

**Local results:** docs-only, so there is no code build or test. Merged with main, no conflict markers.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Changelog line is `none`, which is fine for docs.
- The body says "Fixes"-free (`Refs`-style) on #41, which is right since it does not close it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
